_comment: The other half of grounding (see _index.md and the mechanics.json sibling): the world's actual current material state - what's really there, derived from the external region-file/machine-vision pipeline (not part of this repo), which already does its own description-generation before handing this system JSON, so nothing in this repo processes it further. Intended entry shape once that pipeline starts delivering output: {id, location, text, center: {x, z}, radius, sources: [], embodiment: 'minecraft'} - `location` should be the `id` of an actual entry in _lore/encodings.json's `locations` array (a real reference, not a loose string match), and scripts/lore/sample_grounding.py's gate needs a character's own recorded location values - `places_visited` (accumulated over a character's life, routine and one-off visits alike, not just the fixed `routines[].location` list) - to contain that same id before it connects a character to this entry; `center`/`radius` support the settlement-radius synthesis idea (two differently-described things in _lore/material/ that both fall inside the same radius may be the same real place - flagged mechanically, never merged automatically; the connection has to be a character's own move, in a scene or in reflection). Deliberately empty until real output arrives - do not hand-author placeholder entries here, this file is meant to be ground truth read off the live world, not invented, and is allowed to disagree with what _lore/material/ says about the same place (see _index.md's Troy distinction).
